headline: Ramayana Day 19: ₹12.70 Cr India nett
lede: Ramayana closed Day 19 on Tuesday, 24 November 2026 at ₹12.70 Cr India nett and ₹15.15 Cr India gross, -64.3% from Day 18's ₹35.60 Cr. That day played on 15,696 shows at 17% occupancy. This is the closed day on the desk, not a live estimate.
body:
Through Day 20 the desk has Ramayana at ₹990.5 Cr India nett, ₹1,162.2 Cr India gross, ₹575.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,737.2 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹972.95 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, O.M Operation Mole at ₹5.40 Cr and Aakasamlo Oka Tara at ₹3.25 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. The desk figure remains ₹990.5 Cr India nett and ₹1,737.2 Cr worldwide. No producer-certified total is included.
